comment: * An interface to various time zone lookup behaviors.

methods.name: public OffsetResult lookupByNitzCountry(@NonNull NitzData nitzData, @NonNull String isoCountryCode)
methods.comment:
* Looks for a time zone for the supplied NITZ and country information. * *

Note: When there are multiple matching zones then one of the matching candidates * will be returned in the result. If the current device default zone matches it will be * returned in preference to other candidates. This method can return {@code null} if no * matching time zones are found.

methods.name: public OffsetResult lookupByNitz(@NonNull NitzData nitzData)
methods.comment:
* Looks for a time zone using only information present in the supplied {@link NitzData} object. * *

Note: Because multiple time zones can have the same offset / DST state at a given * time this process is error prone; an arbitrary match is returned when there are multiple * candidates. The algorithm can also return a non-exact match by assuming that the DST * information provided by NITZ is incorrect. This method can return {@code null} if no matching * time zones are found.

methods.name: public CountryResult lookupByCountry(@NonNull String isoCountryCode, long whenMillis)
methods.comment:
* Returns information about the time zones used in a country at a given time.
     *
     * {@code null} can be returned if a problem occurs during lookup, e.g. if the country code is
     * unrecognized, if the country is uninhabited, or if there is a problem with the data.

methods.comment:
* Returns {@code true} if the specified {@code totalOffset} and {@code isDst} would be valid in
     * the {@code timeZone} at time {@code whenMillis}. {@code totalOffetMillis} is always matched.
     * If {@code isDst} is {@code null} this means the DST state is unknown so DST state is ignored.
     * If {@code isDst} is not {@code null} then it is also matched.
